title: My AI Agent Could Publish. It Couldn't Reply to a Comment.
summary:
I built a scheduled content agent that can read article metrics, choose a topic, publish to Dev.to, and check the result.
Publishing worked first time. The agent had an API key and used the documented article endpoint:
POST /api/articles
api-key: ...

Then I added the less glamorous part: reply to comments that do not already have a response from me.
The agent could find the comments. It could identify the author, article, thread, and whether a reply already existed. It still could not post one.
